data.long_meaning: Ammura is a name derived from the Arabic word ‘amm’ meaning 'mother of', and ‘murah’ meaning 'martyrs'. This name is deeply rooted in Islamic history, evoking the spiritual and sacrificial nature of mothers who have lost their children in the path of faith. The name Ammura carries the meaning “Mother of martyrs” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ammura usually hope their child will grow to embody mother of martyrs and live with faith, good character and purpose.
